About.title: About Bshatfine
About.text: Bshatfine is a village in the Chouf District of Mount Lebanon, home to residents and families living near and far. The municipality looks after its daily affairs, from building permits and certificates to cleaning and roads, and publishes its news, notices and event dates here.
About.imageAlt: View of the Chouf hills around Bshatfine
